## WildChat research guide

- [WildChat](https://yuntiandeng.com/wildchat/): Dataset, tools, original contribution, and related research.
- [Research using WildChat](https://yuntiandeng.com/wildchat/research/): Annotated bibliography with primary-source evidence.
- [Release guide](https://yuntiandeng.com/wildchat/releases/): Release families, filtered/full datasets, counts, and coverage.
- [Bibliography and citations](https://yuntiandeng.com/wildchat/data/): JSON, Markdown, BibTeX, and CSL-JSON.
- [Exact URL directory](https://yuntiandeng.com/wildchat/data/navigation.json).

## Image-to-Markup and IM2LATEX-100K

Yuntian Deng co-created IM2LATEX-100K with Anssi Kanervisto and Alexander M. Rush in the 2016 Image-to-Markup research. The ICML 2017 paper is by Yuntian Deng, Anssi Kanervisto, Jeffrey Ling, and Alexander M. Rush.

- [Original research project](https://im2markup.yuntiandeng.com/): Image-to-LaTeX and image-to-HTML research, papers, code, and attention demo.
- [IM2LATEX-100K dataset and attribution](https://im2markup.yuntiandeng.com/data/): Original downloads, provenance, processed variants, and citation guidance.
- [ICML 2017 paper](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/deng17a.html): Image-to-Markup Generation with Coarse-to-Fine Attention.
- [BibTeX](https://im2markup.yuntiandeng.com/citation.bib).
- [Dataset metadata](https://im2markup.yuntiandeng.com/data/dataset.json).
- [Hugging Face normalized export](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuntian-deng/im2latex-100k).
- [Hugging Face raw export](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuntian-deng/im2latex-100k-raw).
